item_name: Rothco Vintage Deluxe Army Low Profile Insignia Cap
item_short_desc: Show your support for those who defend America’s freedom with Rothco’s Vintage Deluxe Army Low Profile Insignia Cap. The front 2 panels of this baseball cap are highlighted with large embroidered "ARMY" lettering, making a bold statement. The brim is accented with an embroidered eagle design and the text "Army Defending Americas Freedom," adding a unique and patriotic touch. Constructed from durable and strong washed cotton twill, this rugged cap is designed to withstand wear and tear while providing a comfortable fit.
